verdict.rationale: User-defined event-triggered automation is a fair question for equity-management SaaS, so the axis applies. However, the evidence shows only a fixed, built-in email notification on vesting events (pulley-docs-37). That is an adjacent feature, not a capability for users to define their own rules that trigger actions, so the verdict is none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
